title: Graph Neural Networks Based Analog Circuit Link Prediction
core_idea: Introduce GNN-ACLP, a graph-neural-network method for analog circuit link prediction that addresses three challenges—leveraging topological patterns, alleviating data scarcity, and improving netlist-format adaptability—via (1) the SEAL framework to learn from subgraphs, embeddings, and attributes for port-level link prediction, (2) Netlist Babel Fish, a netlist format conversion tool using retrieval-augmented generation with a large language model, and (3) the creation of the SpiceNetlist dataset with 775 annotated circuits across 7 types and 10 component classes.
tldr: Use GNNs enhanced by subgraph-based learning, an LLM-powered netlist conversion tool, and a new annotated dataset to improve analog circuit link prediction and netlist compatibility.
